spans.s:
(श्रि) r. 1st cl. (श्रयति-ते)
To serve.
With आङ् prefixed,
1 To seek asylum, to depend upon, to have recourse to.
2 To be near to.
3 To use, to employ.
With अप and आङ्,
To quit, to forsake.
With उत् or सम and उत्,
To be high or elevated.
With वि, अप, and आङ्,
1 To fall, to prostrate, to worship.
2 To expect, to rely upon, to trust to.

r. 9th cl. (श्रीणाति श्रीणीते)
To cook, to dress.
r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रयति-ते श्रायति-ते)
To satisfy.

f. (-श्रीः)
1 Fortune, prosperity, success, thriving.
2

Wealth.
3

Beauty, splendour, lustre.
4

Light.
5

The three objects of life collectively, or love, duty, and wealth.
6 Dress, decoration.
7 State, paraphernalia.
8 Superhuman power.
9 Intellect, understanding.
10 Elevation, consequence.
11 Fame, glory.
12 The goddess LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU, and deity of plenty and prosperity.
13 A name of

SARASVATI.
14

The mother of KUNTHU, the seventeenth Jina of the present age.
15 The Saral tree, (Pinus longifolia.)
16

Cloves.
17

A prefix to the names of deities, forming a kind of invocation at the beginning of a letter, &c. and often used repeatedly, as Śrī Śrī DURGĀ; also a prefix of respect to proper names of persons, as Śri JAYADEVA; also of works, as Śrī Bhāgavata: this use of it is elliptical; the possessive aff. मतुप् or adj. युक्त joined, &c. being understood, and the sense will then be, the splendid, the illustrious, the famous, &c.
E.
श्रि to serve, (i. e. whom the world worships,) क्विप् aff. and the vowel made long.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Cherished, protected, refuged.
2 Served, honored, worshipped.
3 Joined with, contiguous to, connected with.
4 Covered, overspread.
5 Having, possessing.
E.
श्रि to serve, क्त aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Served, honored.
2 Taking refuge with.
E.
श्रि to serve, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं)
Haughty, confident in wealth, beauty, &c.
E.
श्री, and मन्य who thinks, the vowel of the first made short.

(उ) श्रिषु r. 10th cl. (श्रेषति)
To burn.

m. (-शः)
1 VIṢṆ

RĀMACANDRA.
E.
श्री the goddess LAKṢMĪ, also incarnate in SĪTĀ, and ईश husband.

IVA.
2
A country N. W. of Dehli, or about

Tahnesar.
3

BHAVABHŪTI, the author of the Mālati Mādhava, a celebrated drama.
E.
श्री prosperity or eloquence, कण्ठ the throat.

m. (-नः)
BHAVABHŪTI, the poet.
E.
श्रीकण्ठ, and पद the name or title, लाञ्छन a mark; he who is known by the title of Śrīkaṇṭha.

m. (-खः)
KUVERA.
E.
श्रीकण्ठ ŚIVA, and सखि the friend.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Giving fortune or prosperity.
m. (-रः)
VIṢṆU.
n. (-रं)
The red lotus.
E.
श्री fortune, and कर who makes or confers.

m. (-णः)
A pen.
E.
श्री the word Śrī, and करण implement of making.

m. (-न्तः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
श्री the goddess, and कान्त husband.

f. (-री)
An antelope.
E.
श्री increasing, (nourishment,) कर maker, aff. ङीष्, the flesh being considered as highly digestible and nutritive.

mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं)
Sandal wood.
E.
श्री fortune, and खण्ड part.

n. (-तं)
One of the minor dramatic compositions, a piece in one act, dedicated chiefly to the goddess of prosperity.
E.
श्री, and गदित said.

m. (-र्ब्भः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
श्री fortune, and गर्ब्भ womb or origin.

m. (-हः)
A place for watering birds.
E.
श्री wealth, and ग्रह taking.

n. (-नं)
Sour curds.
m. (-नः)
A Buddha or Bauddha saint.
E.
श्री prosperity, and घन a heap.

n. (-क्रं)
1 A magical diagram.
2 An astrological division of the body, the uterine or pubic region.
3 A wheel of INDRA'S car.
4 The circle of the globe or earth.
E.
श्री prosperity, &c., and चक्र a wheel.

m. (-जः)
The deity of love.
E.
श्री LAKṢMĪ, and ज born.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Conferring wealth, prosperity, &c.
m. (-दः)
KUVERA, the god of riches.
E.
श्री wealth, and द who gives.

m. (-रः)
1 VIṢṆ

A Jina of the past period.
E.
श्री the goddess, or good fortune, and घर who has.

m. (-नः)
The deity of love, KĀMA.
E.
श्री LAKṢMĪ, and नन्दन the son.

m. (-नः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
श्री the goddess, and निकेतन abode.

m. (-सः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
श्री the goddess, and निवास abode.

m. (-तिः)
1 VIṢṆ

A king, a prince.
E.
श्री the goddess of fortune or rank, and पति husband or master.

m. (-थः)
A highway, a royal road.
E.
श्री royal paraphernalia, and पथ for पयिन् road.

n. (-र्णं)
1 A lotus.
2 A tree, the wood of which is used to procure fire by attrition, (Premna spinosa).
f. (-र्णी)
1 A shrub, (Gmelina arborea.)
2 A medicinal plant, commonly

Kāyaphal.
3

The silk-cotton tree.
4 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes).
E.
श्री beauty or the goddess, and पर्ण a leaf.

f. (-का)
A medicinal shrub, commonly Kayaphal.
E.
कन् added to the last.

m. (-ष्टः)
Turpentine.
E.
श्री the Śarala or pine, and पिष्ट pounded, ground.

m. (-त्त्रः)
1 A horse.
2 KĀMA.
E.
श्री fortune, or the goddess, and पुत्त्र a son.

m. (-लः)
A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.)
f. (-ली)
1 The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.)
2 Emblic myrobalan.
E.
श्री beauty or the goddess, (to whom it may be offered,) and फल fruit.

m. (-द्रः)
A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.)
E.
श्री LAKṢMĪ, and भद्र auspicious.

m. (-ता)
A horse.
E.
श्री the goddess, भ्रातृ brother; being recovered as well as LAKṢMĪ, at the churning of the ocean.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
1 Wealthy, opulent.
2 Pleasing, beautiful.
3 Prosperous, fortunate, thriving.
4 Famous, illustrious.
m. (-मान्)
1 A tree, commonly Tila or

Tilaka.
2
VIṢṆ

KUVERA, the god of wealth.
4 ŚIVA.
E.
श्री beauty, &c., मतुप् aff.

m. (-कः)
Garlick.

m. (-खः)
The seventh year of the Indian cycle.
E.
श्री prosperity, and मुख chief.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Famous, illustrious.
2 Fortunate, wealthy.
E.
श्री prosperity, and युक्त joined with, possessing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Famous, illustrious.
2 Fortunate, wealthy.
E.
श्री fortune, and युत joined.

m. (-सः)
Turpentine.
E.
श्री the Śarala tree or pine, and रस juice.

m. (-रः)
The third of the Rāgas or personified musical modes.
E.
श्री illustrious, राग the mode.

m. (-मः)
RĀMACANDRA.
E.
श्री celebrated, and राम the name of the prince.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Fortunate, prosperous.
2 Rich, wealthy.
E.
श्री fortune, लच् poss. aff.

m. (-त्सः)
1 VIṢṆ

A particular mark, usually said to be a curl of hair, on the breast of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, and represented in delineations of him by .
3 A hole in a wall made for felonious purposes.
4 The emblem of the tenth Jina, or the mark above ascribed to VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA.
E.
श्री LAKṢMĪ, and वत्स dear to.

m. (-की)
A horse having a curl of hair on his breast.
E.
श्रीवत्स the mark of VIṢṆU, कन् aff. of comparison, and इनि poss. aff.

m. (-भृत्)
VIṢṆU.
E.
श्रीवत्स the mark so termed, and भृत् having.

m. (-नः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
श्रीवत्स the figure so named, and लाञ्छन sign, mark, (whose.)

m. (-ङ्कः)
VIṢṆU: see the last.
E.
श्रीवत्स, and अङ्क mark.

m. (-हः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
श्री illustrious, वराह the boar Avatāra.

Turpentine.
2
VIṢṆ

A lotus.
4 ŚIVA.
E.
श्री the Śarala or pine, or LAKṢMĪ, &c., and वास abode.

n. (-सः)
Turpentine.

m. (-क्षः)
The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.)
E.
श्री auspicious, and वृक्ष a tree.

m. (-कः)
A curl or lock of hair on the chest of a horse: a various reading perhaps for श्रीवत्सक; see श्रीवत्सकिन्.

m. (-ष्टः)
Turpentine.
E.
श्री the Śarala or pine tree, and वेष्ट extract.

n. (-ज्ञं)
Cloves.
E.
श्री LAKṢMĪ, and सज्ञा appellation, the names of the goddess being all applied to the spice.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
श्री the goddess, and सहोदर uterine brother; being reproduced with her and other objects, at the churning of the ocean.

f. (-नी)
The sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.)
E.
श्री LAKṢMĪ, हस्त the hand, इनि and ङीष् aff.; held in the hand of the goddess.

(उ) स्रिभु r. 1st cl. (स्रेभति)
To hurt or kill.

(उ) स्रिम्भु r. 1st cl. (स्रिम्भति)
To hurt or kill.

(उ) स्रिवु r. 4th cl. (स्रिव्यति)
1 To go.
2 To dry.
